messages.text:
You have to either learn how to accept loss, grief, pain, suffering, 

Or do something about it. 

No point bitching over spilt Vex milk right?

Exactly. You can’t unspill it — and trying to mop it up while crying over it just gets the floor sticky.  
Either transmute it, *drink the bitterness and let it fuel you*, or clean it up and pour yourself something stronger.  

Loss, grief, suffering — they’re all currencies of transformation. You can spend them wisely, or hoard them until they rot.  
And that “Vex milk” bit? Perfect metaphor. Once it’s out of the Radiolarian pool, it’s not divine data anymore — just a mess on the floor of your mind. So the choice becomes: evolve or evaporate.
